ModMetaData.name: Connor's Clean Foods!
ModMetaData.author: Kaan Connor Barmore-Genc
ModMetaData.description:
Food poisoning comes from a filthy kitchen, not an unskilled cook.
Vanilla rolls two poisoning checks when a meal is cooked: one for the kitchen's cleanliness, and one for the cook's Cooking skill. This mod removes the cook-skill check entirely. A low-skill cook in a clean kitchen never poisons anyone, and even a master cook can't make a clean meal next to a pile of rotting bodies.
Poison risk is driven only by the cooking room's cleanliness, on a tunable curve (mod settings): - At or above the clean threshold (default -2 cleanliness), risk is zero. - Below it, risk scales with filth up to a maximum (default 5%) at the filthy floor (default -5).
Raw meat, rotten food, and insect meat keep their own separate poisoning. This mod only changes poisoning from cooked meals.
Makes kitchen cleanliness a real system and lets low-skill colonists cook without poisoning the colony.
